name: Lincare (Partner)
desc:
CPAP Resupply | $14.00 - $15.25/hr + Monthly Incentive Bonuses | Scripted Calls | 100% Remote for OK
https://myjobs.adp.com/externallincarecareers/cx/job-listing?keyword=74023

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Lincare is one of the largest durable medical equipment companies in the world, founded in 1972 and part of the Linde Companies, which has been around since the 1800s. Their CPAP resupply division is the largest revenue-generating division in the entire company, with monthly goals of $60 million or more. When someone uses a CPAP machine, they need to regularly replace their supplies, filters, tubing, headgear, masks, cushions, and water chambers, and insurance covers those replacements. Your job is to call existing Lincare CPAP patients using an automated dialer, remind them their supplies are due, set them up on automatic recurring orders so supplies arrive like an Amazon subscription without them having to call, and handle basic account questions.
Key responsibilities from the posting and partnership meeting:
Take outbound dialer calls and inbound return calls from current Lincare CPAP patients
Explain supply replacement benefits clearly and educate patients on why it matters for their health and compliance
Set up recurring supply orders to build predictable revenue and earn toward your incentive goal
Handle select inbound customer service tasks such as insurance changes, account questions, and return requests
Transfer calls outside your scope, such as billing disputes or mask fitting requests, to the appropriate Lincare center
Stay on script consistently to maintain your quality score
Document interactions accurately using Lincare's internal knowledge base and systems including AS/400 and Citrix
Work 100 to 120 back-to-back calls per day
You are not selling machines or oxygen. You are working exclusively with existing patients on supply reorders. The patient population skews older, so warm, patient, active listening is as important as the sales skill. Lincare provides a detailed internal knowledge base called the CC Sub-iclopedia with step-by-step instructions, mask photos, part numbers, and transfer guidance so you are never expected to know everything from memory.
assessment:
https://www.digitalliteracyassessment.org/ Click on Try an Assessment Now, then Windows 11. 
Candidates complete a Windows 11 skills assessment through NorthStar during the interview process and must score 85% or higher to move forward. The assessment can only be retaken once every 24 hours. It covers basic computer skills, browser identification, operating systems, and technology terminology. Lincare does not teach basic computer skills in training, so candidates must already be comfortable in a Windows 11 environment before applying. Three separate system checks are also conducted: at the time of the interview, right before the start date, and again on day one of training.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED required.
 Required Experience: Inside sales experience with demonstrated ability to meet metrics and quotas. Candidates must be able to explain the sales process and describe prior experience hitting goals. Typing minimum 25 WPM
 Preferred Experience:
Automated dialer experience
Experience with older adult patient populations
AS/400 system familiarity is a bonus. AS/400 is a tab and function key system, no pointing and clicking, no Ctrl C or Ctrl V. Exposure to this system before starting would be advantageous
Required Skills:
Active listening with warm, patient communication especially with older adult callers
Ability to stay on script consistently throughout every call
Basic self troubleshooting

 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with inside sales experience who has worked metrics and quotas and can explain their sales process clearly in an interview
Participants who are warm, upbeat, and genuinely patient with older adult callers who may be the only person they talk to all day
People who can stay on a script without sounding robotic and can handle objections or slow periods without losing motivation
Anyone who fully meets the equipment and internet requirements or can access a WRO private office space as a bridge
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who cannot score 85% or higher on the Windows 11 NorthStar assessment
Anyone whose internet is satellite, T-Mobile home internet, or apartment complex WiFi. These are hard disqualifiers
Participants who need remote work to substitute for childcare. Lincare is explicit on this and it has ended prior partnerships
Anyone who cannot commit to 100% attendance for the first 90 days or has pre-planned time off they have not disclosed before their start date
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:

CPAP resupply
Recurring order management
Healthcare sales

Script-based sales
Patient communication
Sales metrics and quotas
DME insurance verification
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 After applying, expect a phone screen first. This is followed by a virtual interview on Microsoft Teams where additional questions are asked and a system check is conducted to verify equipment and internet specs. Candidates must have a qualifying computer and proper internet confirmed before an offer is submitted. Monitors are considered easier to obtain and may not need to be in place at interview time. The NorthStar Windows 11 skills assessment is also completed during this stage and requires an 85% score to move forward. After the offer is accepted, background check takes approximately two weeks. The entire process from application to offer can move as quickly as one day if the candidate is fully ready, but background check adds approximately two weeks before a start date. Training starts every Monday.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you had to meet a sales metric or quota and how you stayed on track when calls were not converting.
How do you stay upbeat and energetic through 100 or more back-to-back calls in a day?
Describe your experience with an automated dialer system and how you managed your pace and performance.
Walk me through how you would handle a call where a patient is on Medicare that day and you cannot set up a recurring order. How do you stay motivated?
other:
Participants CAN use a co-working space. Equipment is NOT provided, must be hardwired to the internet, no Mac or Chromebooks. 
Lincare uses AS/400 as one of their primary systems. It is a tab and function key system that many people find disorienting if they have never used it. Any AS/400 exposure before starting is a genuine advantage. WRO is exploring whether a dummy AS/400 training account could be created for participant prep, which Geri supported enthusiastically.
Remote work cannot substitute for childcare. This is a firm Lincare expectation that ended a prior workforce partnership. It must be communicated clearly to every participant before referral.
100% attendance is required for the first 90 days. Pre-planned time off must be disclosed before the start date so Lincare can adjust the start date if needed. Surprises on day two of training do not go well.
Career Pathway: Remote Inside Sales Representative → Senior Inside Sales Representative → Sales Team Lead → Inside Sales Supervisor → Regional Sales Manager
